candidates.title: 맵/필터 패턴
candidates.concept_granularity: single simplest stream pattern handling each event on its own to drop or transform it, needing no state and therefore no recovery, so failover and load balancing are trivial and a plain producer and consumer suffice

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 단일 이벤트 처리

candidates.title: 로컬 상태를 사용한 집계
candidates.concept_granularity: single pattern making group-wise aggregation possible without shared state, by partitioning so every event for one key lands on one partition and each instance keeps state only for the keys it owns

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 로컬 상태와 스트림 처리

candidates.title: 로컬 상태의 메모리 제약
candidates.concept_granularity: single constraint that local state ideally fits in the instance's memory, since spilling it to disk costs significant performance even where the store supports it

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 로컬 상태와 스트림 처리

candidates.title: 로컬 상태의 영속성
candidates.concept_granularity: single durability arrangement in which the embedded store keeps state in memory and on disk while every change is also written to a Kafka topic, so a lost node rebuilds its state by replaying that topic, which log compaction keeps bounded

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 로컬 상태와 스트림 처리
## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 로컬 상태와 스트림 처리

candidates.title: 리밸런싱과 로컬 상태
candidates.concept_granularity: single handover obligation in which the instance losing a partition must persist its last state so whichever instance receives that partition can restore it

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 로컬 상태와 스트림 처리

candidates.title: 다단계 처리와 리파티셔닝
candidates.concept_granularity: single pattern for results needing all the data: each instance aggregates locally, writes to a single-partition topic small enough for one instance to reduce, and the framework hides which worker runs which stage

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 다단계 처리/리파티셔닝

candidates.title: 외부 검색의 비용
candidates.concept_granularity: single cost of enriching events by querying an outside store - milliseconds per record and a throughput gap of roughly ten to one against the stream - which forces the data to be cached inside the application

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 스트림-테이블 조인

candidates.title: 변경 데이터 캡처
candidates.concept_granularity: single technique of receiving a database's changes as an event stream, which Connect's connectors provide so an application can hold its own copy of a table and update it as the source changes, without loading the database or its other clients

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 스트림-테이블 조인

candidates.title: 스트림-테이블 조인
candidates.concept_granularity: single join in which one side is a stream of changes to a locally cached table

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 스트림-테이블 조인

candidates.title: 테이블-테이블 조인
candidates.concept_granularity: single unwindowed join over both tables' current state, an equi-join when the two are partitioned the same way so the work spreads across instances, with foreign-key joins also supported

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 테이블-테이블 조인

candidates.title: 윈도우 조인
candidates.concept_granularity: single join of two unbounded streams matching events that share a key within the same time window, which Kafka Streams supports when both are partitioned on the join key by assigning matching partitions to one task and holding the join window in its state store

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 스트리밍 조인(윈도우 조인)

candidates.title: 비순차 이벤트
candidates.concept_granularity: single problem of events arriving late - common when a disconnected device reconnects and dumps hours of backlog - requiring the application to notice the event is old, bound how far back it will reconcile, reprocess within one running process rather than rerunning a batch, and be able to amend a result it has already emitted

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 비순차 이벤트
## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 비순차 이벤트

candidates.title: 비순차 이벤트의 프레임워크 지원
candidates.concept_granularity: single framework capability keeping event time independent of processing time and holding several aggregation windows mutable in local state, where a longer mutable period costs proportionally more memory

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 비순차 이벤트

candidates.title: 지연 이벤트로 인한 결과 갱신
candidates.concept_granularity: single amendment mechanism in which aggregation results go to a compacted topic keeping only the newest value per key, so a late event is absorbed by writing the window's new result over the old one

locators.heading: ## 스트림 처리 디자인 패턴 > ### 비순차 이벤트

candidates.title: 신버전 병행 재처리
candidates.concept_granularity: single reprocessing strategy running the new version in its own consumer group from the first offset, producing a second result stream to compare against the old one before clients are switched over

candidates.title: 초기화 후 재처리
candidates.concept_granularity: single reprocessing strategy rewinding the existing application to the start and clearing its local state and previous output so the two versions' results cannot mix, riskier than running the new version alongside the old

candidates.title: 인터랙티브 쿼리
candidates.concept_granularity: single access path reading the application's distributed state directly instead of consuming the result topic, faster and simpler when the result is a table and the result stream is only its update log
